meta: Ask AI to fix Vietnamese spelling without losing your voice: many people get back a brand-new text with perfect spelling that no longer sounds like them.

muc.title: Spell-checking that erases your voice
muc.text: Ask AI to check spelling and many people get back a brand-new text: correct, but no longer in their voice.

muc.title: Only mark the mistakes
muc.text: Tell AI to only mark spelling mistakes and clumsy sentences, with a reason, and never rewrite whole paragraphs.

muc.title: You decide each change
muc.text: Go through each mistake AI found. Fix the real ones, and keep regional expressions that are just how you talk.

muc.title: AI makes mistakes too
muc.text: AI can also get tone marks or names wrong, so check a dictionary when in doubt.

muc.title: A three-column table
muc.text: Paste something you just wrote, ask a chatbot for a three-column table of original sentence, problem and suggestion, then fix it yourself.
